title: Lead Analyst - Frontend & Mobile Architect
description:
Location: Chennai  

Experience: 10\+ years  

Position Type: Full time  

Category: Software Architect  

  

  

Position Description  

  

At CGI, We are seeking an experienced Senior Frontend \& Mobile Architect to lead the design and implementation of enterprise scale web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands on expertise in modern frontend frameworks (React, Angular, Vue, Nextjs) and mobile technologies (React Native, Flutter, Angular with Ionic or similar) with strong architectural vision, performance optimization skills, and user experience awareness.  

This architect will define standards for frontend design systems, API integration, state management, and deployment pipelines, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and alignment with security and DevOps practices. The role requires collaborating closely with backend, DevOps, and product teams to ensure seamless integration across the full stack and consistent delivery of high quality applications.  



**Your future duties and responsibilities**


Your Future Duties and Responsibilities  

  

. Define and lead the frontend and mobile architecture roadmap, ensuring scalable and modular design across projects.  

. Architect responsive and performant web and mobile applications aligned with UX/UI guidelines and accessibility standards.  

. Establish code quality, design system, and component library standards across frontend teams.  

. Oversee the development and optimization of React, Angular, or Vue.js web applications and React Native/Flutter or Angular/Ionic mobile apps.  

. Govern the frontend–backend integration, API gateway usage, and data flow using secure and optimized communication practices.  

. Drive frontend performance optimization (lazy loading, code splitting, caching, PWA strategies).  

. Define best practices for state management (Redux, MobX, Context API, NgRx) and routing.  

. Collaborate with backend and DevOps teams to integrate CI/CD pipelines for web and mobile deployments (Jenkins, Gitlab CI/CD).  

. Enforce frontend security standards (CSP, OWASP, input validation, secure API communication, OAuth2 integration).  

. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to frontend and mobile developers.  

. Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and solution validation sessions.  

. Stay current with evolving frameworks, libraries, and mobile technologies to drive innovation in product development  

  



**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Required Qualifications to Be Successful in This Role  

  

. 10\+ years of total experience in software development, with 5\+ years in frontend/mobile architecture.  

. Proven experience in designing and deploying enterprise scale web and mobile apps.  

. Expertise in React.js, Angular, Nextjs or Vue.js for modern web applications.  

. Strong hands on experience with React Native or Flutter for cross platform mobile development.  

. Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap).  

. Familiarity with design systems (Storybook, Material UI) and UI libraries.  

. In depth knowledge of frontend security best practices and OAuth2 / OpenID integration.  

. Strong understanding of RESTful API, GraphQL, and backend data integration.  

. Experience optimizing builds with Webpack, Vite, or similar bundlers.  

. Familiarity with mobile app deployment pipelines (App Store, Play Store, CI/CD).  

. Exposure to cloud hosting (AWS Amplify, S3, CloudFront, Firebase) and DevOps integration.  

. Excellent leadership, communication, and cross team collaboration skills  

  

\#LI\-SB15

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Product Builder - Python & React/Vue
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a **Product Builder** who enjoys turning ideas into working products and solving practical problems through technology.

You’ll work across the application stack, take ownership of features from development through production, and collaborate closely with the team to build and improve our products.

This role would suit someone with around **2–3 years of experience in product or application development** who is comfortable learning new technologies and taking responsibility for what they build.

What You'll Work With

* **Python** for backend/application development
* **React, Vue, or a similar modern frontend framework**
* AI\-assisted development tools such as **Cursor, Claude Code, Codex**, or similar tools
* Application deployment and production environments
* CI/CD, cloud platforms, monitoring, and related engineering practices

Experience with CI/CD, cloud deployment, and monitoring is **not mandatory**. We value candidates who are willing to learn and take ownership of these areas.

What We're Looking For

* Around **2–3 years of software/product/application development experience**
* Strong working knowledge of **Python**
* Experience with **React, Vue, or a similar frontend framework**
* Ability to understand a requirement and turn it into a working feature
* Comfortable using modern AI\-assisted coding and development tools
* Willingness to learn cloud deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, and production practices
* Ability to take ownership of a feature from **idea → development → deployment → improvement**
* A curious, practical approach to solving real\-world problems
* Good communication and a collaborative approach
* Willingness to learn and work across different parts of the product

What You'll Do

* Build and improve product features across the application stack
* Work with Python and modern frontend technologies
* Take features from initial idea through development and production
* Debug issues and improve application reliability
* Use AI coding tools responsibly to improve development speed and productivity
* Learn and contribute to deployment, CI/CD, cloud, and monitoring practices
* Understand customer and product requirements and translate them into practical solutions
* Continuously improve existing features, processes, and engineering practices

Ownership \& Growth

At our company, engineers have meaningful ownership of what they build. As the product and team grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your technical responsibilities and learn across product development, deployment, and production engineering.

Career Breaks Welcome

We are also open to candidates who are **returning to work after a career break**. If you have relevant skills and are ready to get back into product development, we encourage you to apply.

Work Location

**Remote within Tamil Nadu** or **Hybrid from Chennai**, depending on the candidate and role requirements.

How to Apply

Please include your resume and answer the following two questions in your application.

**Q1\.** Tell us about a time when you were tempted to skip something when you were close to a deadline. What did you actually do?

**Q2\.** In this role, there is no separate team managing production initially. You will own what you build. **Are you comfortable with that?** Please answer **Yes or No, and why, in one line.**

**Applications without answers to both questions may not be considered. Please answer in your own words; we are interested in your actual experience and thinking.**

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
